gloss: cram school director; private school head

definitions.gloss: cram school director; head of a private academy; juku director
definitions.explanation: The head or director of a juku (private tutoring school or cram school). Can also refer to the head of other types of private academies, such as martial arts dojos or traditional schools of learning.

examples.japanese: {塾長|じゅくちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are classes taught directly by the cram school director.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{塾長|じゅくちょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{保護者|ほごしゃ}→保護者：11564_hogosha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面談|めんだん}→面談：08177_mendan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The new cram school director values meetings with parents.

examples.japanese: {塾長|じゅくちょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三十年|さんじゅうねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち→持つ：00478_motsu⟧、⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子|こ}どもたち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学力|がくりょく}→学力：08551_gakuryoku⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}→向上：02731_koujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{貢献|こうけん}して→貢献する：21682_koukensuru⟧きた。
examples.english: The school director has thirty years of teaching experience and has contributed to improving the academic abilities of children in the area.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧ ('cram school; private academy') and {長|ちょう} ('head; chief'). Follows the standard {〜長|ちょう} pattern for leadership titles: ⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧ ('school principal'), ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧ ('company president'), ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧ ('department head').

USAGE:
- Most commonly refers to the owner-operator of a ⟦{学習塾|がくしゅうじゅく}→学習塾：22118_gakushuujuku⟧ (academic cram school)
- Can also apply to the head of a ⟦{道場|どうじょう}→道場：14326_doujou⟧-style academy or a historical {私塾|しじゅく} (private school)
- In historical contexts, refers to the head of famous private schools like {慶應義塾|けいおうぎじゅく} (Keio University's predecessor)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {塾長|じゅくちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as cram school director
- {塾長|じゅくちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧: the director's policy
- {塾長|じゅくちょう}⟦{自|みずか}ら→自ら：00287_mizukara⟧: the director personally
- {塾長|じゅくちょう}⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧: greeting from the director

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧: school principal — the head of a formal public or private school
- ⟦{講師|こうし}→講師：00451_koushi⟧: instructor; lecturer — a person who teaches, but not necessarily the head
- ⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧: cram school — the institution itself, not the person who runs it
